root_cause.text: `dwc2_hsotg_udc_stop()` invokes `dwc2_gadget_exit_clock_gating()` without acquiring `hsotg->lock`, violating the locking expectations of the internal `call_gadget()` macro which performs a spin_unlock/spin_lock sequence.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `spin_lock_irqsave(&hsotg->lock, flags)` and `spin_unlock_irqrestore(&hsotg->lock, flags)` around the call to `dwc2_gadget_exit_clock_gating()` in `dwc2_hsotg_udc_stop()`. The commit message explains that `dwc2_gadget_exit_clock_gating()` internally calls `call_gadget()`, which expects `hsotg->lock` to be held.
